DashPage.dataSecuritySummary: To sync your sports data, this tool needs to log in and store your account credentials on the server. DashPage.dataSecurityDetail1: Please be aware of and agree to the following:
DashPage.dataSecurityDetail2: Related services depend on third parties. We strive to ensure availability but do not guarantee continuous access.
DashPage.dataSecurityDetail3: Due to brand login mechanisms, please do not log in to your account on other devices while using this tool, to avoid invalidating authorization credentials.
DashPage.dataSecurityDetail4: We encrypt and store your information strictly, but cannot completely eliminate potential uncertainties in the network environment. Continued use means you fully understand the above and authorize us to sync and manage your data.
DashPage.taskDescription: Configure data sync tasks to automatically sync your sports data. An account can have multiple tasks; each task holds exactly one source-to-target pair and runs at most 3 times per day. The server checks every hour and triggers the task in the timezone set in your profile, so execution may be delayed by a few minutes.
DashPage.noTasks: No scheduled tasks. Click "{action}" to configure.
DashPage.deleteConfirmDesc: Its sync pairs and execution records will be deleted as well. This cannot be undone.

GptCodePage.title: GPT Auth Code
GptCodePage.desc: Used to authorize OpenAI / ChatGPT connections to incremental.icu.
GptCodePage.loadError: Failed to fetch code, please try again
GptCodePage.step1: Connect incremental.icu in OpenAI / ChatGPT, your browser will be redirected to the authorization page.
GptCodePage.step2: Open this page and copy the 6-digit code above.
GptCodePage.step3: Enter the code on the authorization page and click "Log in and authorize" to complete the connection.
GptCodePage.tips: The code is valid for 5 minutes and can only be used once. Do not share it with anyone.
